title: N0 Design Repo Composition IR (base envelope)
description: Generic contract for a 'design-repo-remix' IR document: a route-by-route site composition targeted at one specific Design Repo. This schema only constrains the envelope shape shared by every remix (irVersion, designRepo pointer, product intent, runtime target, pages[]). It deliberately does NOT know which sections/motions/templates are valid -- that vocabulary belongs to the target Design Repo's own schema/pagespec.schema.json, tokens/llm/component-allowlist.json and compatibility/graph.json. A repository-specific profile schema (allOf: [this schema, {repo consts}]) locks designRepo.* to that repo's real values, and each pages[].pageSpec must additionally validate against the target repo's native pagespec schema.

irVersion.description: Semver of this IR document's own shape, not the design repo's version.

designRepo.description: Identifies the target Design Repo and points at the files that govern generation and validation against it. A repo profile schema pins these to const values for a specific repositoryId.

repositoryVersion.description: The design repo's own version, or an N0 adapter sentinel (e.g. '0.0.0-unversioned') if the repo does not publish one.

contracts.description: Paths, relative to the design repo's root, to the files a generator/validator must resolve. Exact key set may vary by repo; pageSpecSchema and manifest are the load-bearing ones every profile must supply.

contentHash.description: Optional integrity pin over the resolved design repo snapshot used for this generation.

intent.description: Product/business semantics driving what gets generated, independent of the design repo's visual layer.

runtime.description: Where and how the generated site will actually run.

strictDesignRepo.description: When true, generation must only use sections/components/tokens/motions declared in this design repo's own registries -- no cross-repo invention.

allowCrossFamilyMixing.description: When false, this remix may not blend sections/tokens from a different designFamily than designRepo.repositoryId.

retrievalTrace.description: Optional: why this design repo was selected as the source family for this remix.

designPolicy.description: Optional: which domain-level design constraint set (beyond this one repo) governs generation, e.g. a shared saas/marketing policy.

pageRole.description: Free-form semantic role, e.g. conversion | content | standard | legal | not-found.

pageSpec.description: The actual page composition. Its INTERNAL shape is intentionally left open here -- it must be validated separately against the target design repo's own pageSpecSchema (see designRepo.contracts.pageSpecSchema), not against this envelope.
